sections.extract: One way to interpret the stability properties of a given polynomial is via the stability-preservation properties of a particular type of linear operator: the evaluation map. sections.title: B The Grace-Walsh-Szego Coincidence Theorem
sections.extract: The Grace-Walsh-Szeg˝o Coincidence Theorem A classical result in the representation theory of SL2(C) is the fact that V (n) ∼= Symn(V (1)). Here, Symn(V (1)) denotes the set of symmetric tensors in V (1)⊗n, or alternatively, the set of symmetric elements in V (1n). That is, there is some SL2(C)-invariant injection from V (n) to V (1)⊗n, and by our conceptual the- sis this map should transfer stability information.
